jobs.title: 3D Reconstruction Research Scientist
jobs.description_text: ABOUT NIANTIC SPATIAL We are building for the >80% of economic activity that happens beyond the reach of screens. AI has learned from the text, images and video online, but it still lacks an accurate understanding of physical space. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for 3D Reconstruction Research Scientist to join our Research Team in London. Our team researches and builds the 3D reconstruction technology behind Niantic Spatial's platform. About the Role We’re hiring an Electrical Engineer to design, build, and test the electronics behind our flight and ground hardware. This is built for someone a few years into their career who has already put real hardware on a bench and wants a far bigger slice of the system than a large prime can offer. The role is onsite daily at our Ashburn Virginia facility. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Structural Dynamics Engineer to build Overview Energy's structural analysis, verification, and model validation capability from scratch. Every structure we put into orbit has to survive launch and years of thermal cycling. Your analysis is what stands between a design and a satellite that fails silently nearly 36,000 km away. Get it right, and solar farms already on the ground keep producing power after dark. Working daily in our Ashburn, VA office, you'll work alongside our structural, optics, mechanisms, and systems engineering teams. You'll run the simulations, define the tests, build the fixtures, and command the room when the shaker table turns on. Along the way, you'll build the tools, procedures, and test capability this practice runs on for years to come. jobs.description_text: About Revel Revel is the software platform for hardware test and control. Aerospace, defense, robotics, and energy teams use Revel to build control diagrams, stream telemetry, and operate the hardware they're developing. Location: San Francisco, Los Angeles The Role: We’re building a new data platform to add to Revel's current products. The data platform receives, stores, and serves telemetry from our customers' hardware. It helps customers develop and operate their hardware faster and more effectively. Problems you'll work on: - Powerful analysis in the browser. You will build user experiences which help engineers to interactively explore data on time scales ranging from nanoseconds to years, to compare test events, and to calculate derived channels on the fly. - Performance. jobs.description_text: Why Join Stand https://www.standinsurance.com/careers/why-stand/: At Stand, you’ll help build a new class of global property protection. We use advanced physics and AI to model catastrophic risk at the asset level, then automate underwriting and mitigation before loss occurs. Insurance is simply the current delivery mechanism. We stay when traditional insurers exit. We model what others approximate. And we build systems that change outcomes, not just prices. Our leadership team https://www.standinsurance.com/vision has built category-defining companies (Metromile, Policygenius, WePay, HotelTonight) and brings decades of expertise in underwriting, capital management, and reinsurance. Background: The property insurance industry is built to price loss after it happens. It relies on coarse proxies, backward-looking data, and manual processes, then accepts damage as unavoidable. Stand takes a different approach. We simulate how real-world catastrophes affect individual properties, translate that into actionable decisions, and automate the business around it. The result is a platform that can underwrite what others can’t and operate with far less friction. The Problem We’re Solving: A home’s survival in a wildfire or flood depends on its materials, geometry, topography, and defensible space. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Pipelines team at Supabase. Supabase Pipelines is a managed change data capture product. It copies the tables you select from Supabase Postgres to other systems, then streams later changes. The product is in public alpha, with BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckLake and Snowflake destinations. Pipelines uses Postgres logical replication and Supabase ETL, our open source replication engine written in Rust. The team works close to the database. Correctness, ordering and recovery matter there as much as speed. The Engineering Manager is a people, delivery and technical role. We don't expect you to write production code. jobs.title: Storage Platform Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE Supabase runs millions of Postgres databases, and storage performance is now one of the biggest levers on how fast, reliable, and affordable they are. We're building a software-defined, NVMe-over-Fabrics storage platform underneath Supabase Postgres. Postgres stays unmodified, and the new layer delivers near-local-NVMe performance with the durability and flexibility of networked storage. As the senior engineer driving storage, you'll own this effort end to end: the architecture and build-vs-buy decisions, integration into our compute platform, and operating the system in production. Your first goal is raw Postgres I/O performance at scale. In the longer term, the layer you build will provide the block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones behind database branching, fast restores, and instant resizes. Because it's software-defined, it will also travel with us as we expand beyond a single cloud provider into multi-cloud and colocated infrastructure. This is a foundational, high-ownership role. You'll set the technical direction for storage at Supabase and help grow the team around it. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Lead the architecture of Supabase's NVMe-oF storage platform, including

jobs.description_text: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Realtime team at Supabase. Realtime lets developers send low-latency messages between clients, track and synchronize user state, and listen to database changes. Those three features are Broadcast, Presence and Postgres Changes. Broadcast also sends from the database and over HTTP, and clients can replay recent messages. Realtime is a globally distributed Elixir cluster built on Phoenix. The team balances low latency, fair limits between projects, and the cost of running the service. Customers expect connections to stay up, so reliability matters as much as new features. The Engineering Manager is a people, delivery and technical role. We don't expect you to write production code, but you you will lead a team of experienced engineers. We do expect you to join design discussions and help set the bar for engineering quality, testing and operations.
